SELECT 
    astk.SEC_CSNAME AS `股票简称`,
    astk.COMB_SYMBOL AS `股票代码`,
    astk.END_DATE AS `日期`,
    '出海' AS `概念名称`,
    ROUND(
        (
            COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_ASIA_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_OCEANIA_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_EU_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_NON_EU_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_AFRICA_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_MID_EAST_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_LATIN_AMERICA_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_NORTH_AMERICA_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_AMERICA_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_JAPAN_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_KOREA_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_TW_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_RUSSIA_CNY, 0)
        ) / NULLIF(
            COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_ASIA_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_OCEANIA_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_EU_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_NON_EU_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_AFRICA_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_MID_EAST_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_LATIN_AMERICA_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_NORTH_AMERICA_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_AMERICA_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_JAPAN_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_KOREA_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_TW_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_RUSSIA_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_ASIA_CNY, 0) --重复加国内时处理
        , 0) * 100, 2) AS `2025年国外收入占比(%)`,
    ROUND(
        (
            COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_ASIA_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_OCEANIA_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_EU_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_NON_EU_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_AFRICA_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_MID_EAST_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_LATIN_AMERICA_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_NORTH_AMERICA_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_AMERICA_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_JAPAN_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_KOREA_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_TW_CNY, 0)
            + COALESCE(astk.REVENUE_RUSSIA_CNY, 0)
        ) / 100 , 3) AS `2025年国外收入(亿人民币)`
FROM ASTK_REVENUE_OVERSEAS astk
INNER JOIN VW_CONCEPT_STK stk ON astk.COMB_SYMBOL = stk.COMB_SYMBOL AND stk.CONCEPT_NAME = '出海' AND stk.HISVALID = 1
WHERE 
    astk.END_DATE = '2025-12-31'
    AND astk.HISVALID = 1
    AND astk.SEC_CSNAME IS NOT NULL
    AND astk.COMB_SYMBOL IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY `2025年国外收入占比(%)` DESC
